commission_per_share.source: Zero-commission US equity brokers (Schwab, Robinhood, Fidelity) charge no per-share commission on unbundled retail orders; regulatory pass-throughs (SEC 31 fee, FINRA TAF) are sub-basis-point on a round trip and are folded into the half-spread's round-up rather than modelled separately.

entry_extra_slippage.name: entry_extra_slippage
entry_extra_slippage.provenance_meaning: not a measurement; a deliberately adverse rung in a sweep
entry_extra_slippage.source: NOT MEASURED for this population. Zero here makes the model a stated LOWER BOUND on friction, never a claim that impact is absent. b22b_measured_costs() carries this programme's own measurement of the ORB entry instead.

entry_half_spread.name: entry_half_spread
entry_half_spread.provenance_meaning: a peer-reviewed measurement of someone else's orders
entry_half_spread.source: Dyhrberg, Shkilko & Werner, JFE 168 (2025): effective spread 49.06 bp at wholesalers / 46.98 bp at exchanges on marketable retail orders, i.e. a ~2.4 bp half-spread on a liquid name once the ~44%-of-quoted price improvement they measure is applied. Rounded UP to 2.5. Price improvement is not separately credited anywhere else in this rig.

exit_extra_slippage.name: exit_extra_slippage
exit_extra_slippage.provenance_meaning: not a measurement; a deliberately adverse rung in a sweep
exit_extra_slippage.source: NOT MEASURED. Nobody has measured the EXIT leg of this rule at all -- B22B is entry-only by design. Zero here is a stated lower bound on the exit, not a finding about it.

exit_half_spread.name: exit_half_spread
exit_half_spread.provenance_meaning: a peer-reviewed measurement of someone else's orders
exit_half_spread.source: Dyhrberg, Shkilko & Werner, JFE 168 (2025): effective spread 49.06 bp at wholesalers / 46.98 bp at exchanges on marketable retail orders, i.e. a ~2.4 bp half-spread on a liquid name once the ~44%-of-quoted price improvement they measure is applied. Rounded UP to 2.5. Price improvement is not separately credited anywhere else in this rig. Charged on the EXIT leg too: a stop-loss market order and a market-on-close are both taker fills, and neither is cheaper than the entry.

stress_rail.note: Spread and slippage are PER SIDE. round_trip_bp is entry + exit, and is the number to quote. Borrow accrues on CALENDAR days, not trading days. Price improvement is NOT modelled: the full half-spread is charged to every taker fill, which is the conservative side of the B22C uncertainty.

It is run forward because 1990-2026 is burned for it, not because it was certified. Nothing in this log is a return claim, a profit forecast, or evidence of edge. PAPER ACCOUNT ONLY.

rule.status: DEAD ON T13's FROZEN GATE. Positive-signed in every decade and configuration, p = 0.233 on the drawdown gate, DSR = 0.355. Run forward because it cannot honestly be re-run backward, not because it was certified.
rule.timing_convention: T13-L1: exposure for day t uses closes through t-2

sizing.rounding_note: whole shares, rounded DOWN in absolute value: under-filling takes less risk than the sizing authorised, over-filling takes more.

track_record_after.benchmark_definition: un-overlaid buy-and-hold of the same instrument, same start, same cost model, one entry charged. NOTE: this is NOT the null that decides the question. T13's G1 null is a CONSTANT weight vol-matched to the strategy (de-risked buy-and-hold) and it is the gate that killed both families. It cannot be computed until the forward sample has a realised volatility worth matching.
